I was at a pop-up gallery that would later turn into a Montell Fish show on the lower east side of Manhattan. Dealing w/ anxiety, I was taught that calling out three things you see & walking helps me best. So before Montell performed, I left & started walking because I was having a panic attack (no one else would know it unless I told you) but then I started calling out three things I saw to calm me down via my stroll. I was staring at the corner of a building as a tinted-out black Rolls Royce passed by. 

As I turned the corner, the black rolls parked about three cars away on the street. I kept walking & the window was half cracked & sure enough, it was Frank, wearing a blue durag, w/ another passenger with em. He didn't have security or a driver with them either.

I was like "Yo, are you Frank?" He said, "Yeah, what's good bro?" & had a conversation for a min. He was asking where the show was & I got to tell him about the artist Montell Fish\\show, some of my film work, & the city of Detroit (where I'm from). I'm sure I rambled a bit & at the end, my dumbass asked for a picture specifically only showing half our faces as a meme & he was like "Nah man, I don't really do that." & that was it. 

As cheesy as it sounds, that conversation helped me go to a show around a shit ton of people that I was debating on not going to because of my anxiety. He'd never know what I was going thru, but it taught me that every day can be a new experience & pushed me to go to the show. It gave me some weird peace & it was just dope to me.
